get.description: Detects recurring patterns among unlinked expenses and incomes, on demand. A pattern needs a description (digits and symbols are ignored) and, within the lookback: weekly 4+ occurrences in 2 months (+-1 day), monthly 3+ in 6 months (+-4 days), yearly 2+ in 25 months (+-7 days), with amounts within 15% of the median. Dismissed patterns are left out. Ordered by confidence.
